 ORDER:
When the matter was taken up for hearing, none appeared on behalf of the petitioner.

The present petition was filed in the year 2021 seeking to quash F.I.R. No. 289 of 2019, registered under Sections 417 and 376 of the Indian Penal Code, dated 05.10.2019 on the file of Chilakaluripet Town Police Station, Guntur District, and the matter has been pending for the past four to five years.
